description:
Read insights for every story currently live on the account, in one call.

Stories vanish after 24 hours and their insights go with them, so this is the tool for catching a day's story performance before it is lost. Equivalent to instagram_list_stories followed by instagram_get_media_insights on each result.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_story_insights
title: Get Insights for All Live Stories
